subject: Red Wizard

subject: Gaia Magic Shop
text: The Level 8 magic available includes Fade and Wall for the White Wizard, and Stop and Zap! for the Black Wizard.

evidence.quote: The Level 8 magic you want is Fade and Wall for the White Wizard, and Stop and Zap! for the Black Wizard.

subject: Red Wizard
text: The Red Wizard cannot learn any Level 8 magic.

evidence.quote: The Red Wizard can't learn any Level 8 magic.

subject: Submarine
text: A submarine created to go underwater requires Oxyale to run.

evidence.quote: One of the people has created a submarine to go underneath the sea to find the Mermaids, but it needs Oxyale to run.

subject: Dr. Unne
text: Dr. Unne needs a Slab to be able to teach the Lefeinish language.

evidence.quote: Dr. Unne needs a Slab to be able to teach the language.

subject: Caravan
text: The caravan master in the northern section of the western desert sells a Bottle for 50,000 gold.

evidence.quote: The caravan is in the northern section of this desert.  The master has for sale a "Bottle" priced at 50,000 gold.

subject: Bottle
text: Do not use the Bottle until returning to Gaia's spring, or the fairy will fly away and waste 50,000 gold.

evidence.quote: IMPORTANT:  DO NOT USE THE BOTTLE UNTIL YOU GET BACK TO GAIA'S SPRING.  If you do, the fairy will fly away and you'll have wasted 50,000 gold.

subject: Gaia Pond
text: Using the Bottle next to the pond in Gaia summons the fairy, who gives you Oxyale.

evidence.quote: Stand next to the pond and use the Bottle.  The fairy will appear and give you Oxyale.

subject: Submarine
text: Touching the submarine in Onrac while carrying Oxyale transports the party to the Sea Shrine.

evidence.quote: You can pass because you have Oxyale.  Touching the submarine transports you to the Sea Shrine.

subject: Sea Shrine 3rd Floor Western Room
text: The western room on the 3rd floor contains 9900 gold.

evidence.quote: Western room:  9900 gold

subject: Sea Shrine 3rd Floor Eastern Room
text: The eastern room on the 3rd floor contains 2000 gold.

evidence.quote: Eastern room:  2000 gold

subject: Sea Shrine 3rd Floor Northwestern Stairs
text: Stairs in the northwestern corner of the 3rd floor lead down to the 2nd floor.

evidence.quote: Northwestern corner:  Stairs down to 2nd floor

subject: Sea Shrine 3rd Floor Northeastern Stairs
text: Stairs in the northeastern corner of the 3rd floor lead up to the 4th floor.

evidence.quote: Northeastern corner:  Stairs up to 4th floor

subject: Sea Shrine 4th Floor Southwest Room
text: Walking south and west on the 4th floor leads to a room containing 20 gold.

evidence.quote: Walk south and west (ignoring the first room you see) to find a room with 20 gold.

subject: Sea Shrine 4th Floor Northwest Room
text: A room to the northwest on the 4th floor contains Opal Armor.

evidence.quote: Then walk northwest to find a room with Opal Armor.

subject: Sea Shrine 4th Floor Far South Room
text: A room located as far south as possible on the 4th floor contains the Light Axe.

evidence.quote: Walk south as far as you can to find a room with the Light Axe.

subject: Sea Shrine 4th Floor Upper East Room
text: Taking the upper eastern path on the 4th floor leads to a room containing the Mage Staff.

evidence.quote: Then walk east and take the upper path to find a room with the Mage Staff.

subject: Sea Shrine 4th Floor Lower East Room
text: Taking the lower eastern path on the 4th floor leads to a room containing 12350 gold and stairs up to the 5th floor.

evidence.quote: Then go back and take the lower path to find a room with 12350 gold and also the stairs up to the 5th floor.

subject: Sea Shrine 5th Floor
text: Among the treasures on the 5th floor of the Sea Shrine is the Slab needed by Dr. Unne.

evidence.quote: Among the numerous treasures you will get on this floor (including lots of Opal stuff), you will get the Slab that Dr. Unne needs.

subject: Sea Shrine 2nd Floor Northeast Stairs
text: Stairs down to 3rd floor B are located in the northeast corner of the 2nd floor.

evidence.quote: The stairs down to 3rd floor B are in the northeast corner.

subject: Sea Shrine 3rd Floor B
text: Stairs on 3rd floor B lead up to 4th floor B.

evidence.quote: 3rd floor B - Take the stairs up to 4th floor B.

subject: Sea Shrine 4th Floor B
text: Stairs on 4th floor B lead down to 3rd floor C.

evidence.quote: 4th floor B - Take the stairs down to 3rd floor C.

subject: Sea Shrine 3rd Floor C Room
text: The chests in the room on 3rd floor C contain 560 gold.

evidence.quote: The chests in the room contain 560 gold.

subject: Sea Shrine 3rd Floor C South Exit
text: Stairs down to 2nd floor B are located just outside the south exit of the room on 3rd floor C.

evidence.quote: The stairs down to 2nd floor B are just outside the south exit of this room.

subject: Sea Shrine 2nd Floor B Southeast Room
text: Following the intersection south and east on 2nd floor B leads to a room containing 15825 gold.

evidence.quote: Walk west until you reach an intersection, then go south and east to find a room with 15825 gold.

subject: Sea Shrine 2nd Floor B West Room
text: Walking as far west as possible on 2nd floor B leads to a room with a Power Gauntlet and 5835 gold.

evidence.quote: Then walk as far west as you can to find a room with a Power Gauntlet and 5835 gold.

subject: Sea Shrine 2nd Floor B North Room
text: Walking north on 2nd floor B leads to a room containing a Light Axe.

evidence.quote: Then walk to the north to find a room with a Light Axe.

subject: Sea Shrine 2nd Floor B East Room
text: Walking east on 2nd floor B leads to a room containing a Ribbon and 19990 gold.

evidence.quote: Walk to the east to find a room with a Ribbon and 19990 gold.

subject: Sea Shrine 2nd Floor B Northwest Stairs
text: Stairs down to the 1st floor are located to the northwest on 2nd floor B.

evidence.quote: Finally, walk northwest to find the stairs down to the 1st floor.

subject: Kraken
text: Kraken has 800 HP, casts Lit2, and uses the special attack Ink to cause Dark.

evidence.quote:
BOSS:  KRAKEN
HP: 800
Magic:  Lit2
Special Attack:  Ink (Dark)

subject: Kraken
text: Lit3 is a very effective attack spell against Kraken, while Inv2 helps lessen his physical attacks of up to 8 hits.

evidence.quote: Kraken's physical strength is a threat (up to 8 hits per attack!), so use Inv2 to help you lessen that...Lit3 is a very effective attack spell to utilize.

subject: Waterfall Entrance
text: Canoeing north along the river next to Onrac leads to the waterfall.

evidence.quote: Go back to the river next to Onrac and canoe north until you find the waterfall, then enter it.

subject: Waterfall Path
text: Starting from the southeast corner of the Waterfall, follow the forks west, north, west, west, and then all the way south to reach the room.

evidence.quote: You start in the southeast corner of the maze.  Follow these directions for when you come to forks in the path:  west, north, west, west, then walk all the way south.

subject: Robot
text: The Robot inside the Waterfall room gives you the Cube to allow transfer to the Floating Castle.

evidence.quote: Inside the room is the Robot, who gives you the Cube, which he says will allow you to transfer to the Floating Castle.

subject: Dr. Unne
text: Talking to Dr. Unne in Melmond teaches you the language of the Lefeinish.

evidence.quote: Go talk to Dr. Unne in Melmond and he will teach you the language of the Lefeinish.

subject: Lefein Landing
text: To reach Lefein, land the Airship in a tiny patch of grass far to the north next to the mountains and walk south.

evidence.quote: There's a tiny little patch of grass far to the north (next to the mountains at the right side of the desert) and you have to land there and go far to the south to reach the town.

subject: Lefeinish Inhabitant
text: Someone in Lefein gives you the Chime so you can enter the Mirage Tower.

evidence.quote: The entrance to the Floating Castle is the Mirage Tower, which you can enter with the Chime.  Someone will give you that Chime so you can enter it.

subject: Secret Magic Shop
text: Walking east through the break in the trees in northeast Lefein reveals a secret Level 8 magic shop selling Lif2 and Nuke.

evidence.quote: Go through the break in the trees in the northeast part of the town and keep walking east.  You'll find a Level 8 magic shop which sells Lif2 and Nuke.

subject: Mirage Tower 1st Floor Central Room
object: Aegis Shield, Vorpal, Heal Helmet, Cabin, and 30040 gold
text: Chests in the central room on the 1st floor of Mirage Tower contain the Aegis Shield, Vorpal, Heal Helmet, a Cabin, and 30040 gold.

evidence.quote: They contain the Aegis Shield, Vorpal, Heal Helmet, a Cabin, and 30040 gold.

subject: Mirage Tower 2nd Floor Central Room

subject: Blue Dragon

evidence.quote: A Blue Dragon is right inside.

evidence.quote: The robot will tell you that you need a Cube to operate the transporter.  This must be the one that goes to the Floating Castle.

subject: WarMech
text: There is a slight chance of encountering WarMech along the bridge on the 5th floor.

evidence.quote: There's a slight chance you'll have to fight WarMech, who is even more powerful than Tiamat.

BOSS:  TIAMAT

subject: Time Gate
text: The Time Gate at the Temple of Fiends can be broken because the four Orbs shine once again, allowing travel back 2000 years in time.

evidence.quote: You must travel back 2000 years in time to confront this person by breaking the Time Gate at the Temple of Fiends.  It can be broken because the four Orbs shine once again.

subject: Black Orb
text: Approaching the black Orb in the center room allows you to cover it with the four Orbs and travel back 2000 years in time.

evidence.quote: Approach the Orb in the center room.  You will use the four Orbs to cover the black Orb, allowing you to travel back 2000 years in time.

subject: Phantom
text: A Phantom attacks as soon as you enter the center room on the 3rd floor.

evidence.quote: Enter the center room from the bottom.  You'll be attacked by a Phantom as soon as you enter.

subject: Temple of Fiends 3rd Floor Center Room
text: The treasure chests in the center room on the 3rd floor contain 110000 gold.

evidence.quote: The treasure chests contain 110000(!) gold.

subject: Stone Plate
text: Playing the Lute on the Stone Plate allows you to descend.

evidence.quote: Move to the Stone Plate on the floor.  No, the Rod doesn't work on this one.  The Lute does...Descend.

subject: Lich
text: Before descending the stairs to floor B2 in the lower right corner, you must defeat Lich once again.

evidence.quote: The stairs down to floor B2 are in the lower right corner.  However, before you can descend them you must fight the Fiend of the Earth, Lich, once again.
